title: Protect nonpublic information from unauthorized disclosure
abstract: Do not disclose nonpublic or confidential information through public artifacts or communications without authorization. This governs the information disclosed, irrespective of the wording used or how it was obtained.
remarks: Original public-safe intake retained. Authorized analysis and disposition are recorded separately under processing/specimens/. This is not a catalog rule or engineering task.
